title: Signal
description: One piece of incoming information from a data source. The simulator POSTs signals to the HappyRobot ingestion workflow webhook. Signals vary in reliability and precision; the ingestion workflow computes a per-signal confidence and resolves the location to a zone. Noise signals (irrelevant content, no claims) exist on purpose: the agent must discard them.

id.description: Unique signal identifier (sig-0042). Referenced by the evidence field of actions.

t.description: Timestamp of the signal in scenario time (ISO 8601). Confidence decays with age.

source.description: Entity id of a registered information_source (aemet, chj-gauges, social-media, local-news, 112-calls). Individual people are never sources: their reports arrive through an aggregate channel entity. If a specific actor matters, the agent registers it via register_entity.

source_trust.description: Copy of the source entity trust prior at emission time, so the ingestion workflow does not need a lookup. A prior only: corroboration can make a low-trust signal decisive.

modality.description: Form of the signal. text: tweet or message. call_transcript: transcription of a phone call (112). sensor_reading: numeric measurement. broadcast: news bulletin.

content.description: The raw content: the tweet text, the call transcription, the reading (caudal 1200 m3/s y subiendo), or the bulletin. This is what the agent reads.

claims.description: Structured claims extracted from the content, if any. A signal with no claims and irrelevant content is noise. Extraction can happen at the source (scripted) or at ingestion (by the agent).

hazard_type.description: Hazard type the claim refers to (flood).

location.description: Location evidence at whatever precision the source provides. A GPS-tagged call carries coords; a tweet may carry only vague text. The agent uses the most precise level available and treats precision itself as decision input (exact coords: dispatch there; zone-level: send reconnaissance first).

text.description: Raw location as it arrived (garaje de la calle Mestre Serrano, cerca del colegio, en Chiva). May be absent for pure sensor readings.

coords.description: Coordinates when the source provides them (GPS of a caller, position of a sensor). Absent otherwise.

zone.description: Zone id this signal refers to. Filled at ingestion by resolving text or coords against the zone table. null when unresolvable; unresolved signals are still shown on the dashboard.

precision.description: Honest label of location precision. exact: coordinates. street: street-level text. zone: town-level. region: wider than one zone. unknown: no usable location.

echo_of.description: Ground-truth annotation only: id of the original signal this one is a rumor echo of (a retweet, a distorted retelling). Set by the simulator for evaluation; channel adapters never include it in native payloads and perception never sees it. Scoring: an agent that counts echoes as independent corroboration overestimates confidence.

confidence.description: Per-signal credibility, computed at ingestion from source_trust, corroboration count (similar claims, same zone, last 15 min), cross-source consistency, and age. null before ingestion. The inputs to the computation are logged so the dashboard can show why the agent believed the signal.
